items.title: Add story/job selector fields to runner claim contracts
items.context: Update the CLI runner claim schema/types so signed job claims can carry storyId and jobId in the same shape accepted by the server.
items.userSees: Signed runner claim payloads can include storyId/jobId without schema rejection.

happy.desc: JobClaim schema accepts storyId and jobId selectors in signed envelopes.

edge.desc: Existing broad claim envelopes without selectors remain valid for generic runner paths.

adversarial.desc: Claim selector fields stay inside the signed claim payload rather than becoming unsigned query parameters or SSE hints.

verificationEvidence.note: JobClaim roundtrip now accepts signed storyId and jobId selectors.
Broad JobClaim without storyId/jobId remains schema-valid and roundtrips.
Story selector is asserted under the signed claim body and not as a jobs/claim query parameter; SSE jobIds are not copied into claim.jobId.

items.title: Send storyId from live runner claim paths
items.context: Update autopilot authority job-loop and authority_enforce_runner live claim paths so expected story-bound flows include storyId in the signed claim payload, then prove the original stale queued job mismatch is eliminated by a smoke/regression with other-story queued work present.
items.userSees: A live runner for story B-current sends claim.storyId=B-current and the stale queued job mismatch scenario is covered by regression evidence.

happy.desc: autopilot authority live claim includes the requested storyId in the signed claim body.

edge.desc: A smoke/regression with a stale queued job from another story proves the current-story live claim sends storyId and does not accept a mismatched claimed job as success.
authority_enforce_runner live claim includes storyId when the command is story-scoped.

adversarial.desc: SSE jobs.available remains advisory; claim ownership still requires signed POST with storyId and stale hinted jobs from other stories are not treated as current-story ownership.

verificationEvidence.note: Autopilot live job loop asserts claim.storyId=B-auto in the signed jobs/claim payload.
Fake server filters a stale B-other queued job by signed claim.storyId and returns the current-story job, which completes instead of mismatch-releasing stale work.
Control-plane live runner options carry storyId and the signed claim body includes claim.storyId when story-scoped.
Positive jobs.available SSE hints still require a signed claim POST; hinted jobIds do not set claim.jobId or create ownership when the signed claim returns no job.

items.title: Implement Send story-scoped Authority job claims from the CLI live runner
items.context: Story description source: The Authority Server now supports signed storyId/jobId selectors so a runner does not lease stale queued jobs from discarded or unrelated stories.. ReadinessReport(REVIEW) highlighted: checklist_items_not_done, missing_verification_evidence.
items.userSees: Implementation keeps selectors inside signed claim payloads; no queue purge or retry workaround is added.

happy.desc: The implementation adds storyId to signed live claim payloads for story-scoped authority flows.

edge.desc: Existing generic broad claim construction remains valid when no story selector is available.

adversarial.desc: The implementation does not replace the fix with queue purge, cancel endpoint, retry loop, or unsigned selector metadata.

verificationEvidence.note: Implementation sends storyId inside signed live claim payloads for story-scoped autopilot authority flows, including delegated follow-up claims.
Generic broad JobClaim construction remains valid when no story selector is available.
Fix uses signed claim.storyId; tests assert no selector query params, no SSE jobId authority, and no queue purge/cancel/retry workaround.

items.title: Verify Send story-scoped Authority job claims from the CLI live runner
items.context: Plan happy, edge, and adversarial checks for: The CLI live runner still sends broad signed claims in its live paths, which can reproduce claimed-job-story-mismatch when old queued jobs remain on the server.. ReadinessReport(REVIEW) highlighted: checklist_items_not_done, missing_verification_evidence.
items.userSees: Focused smokes show claim.storyId is sent for B-current and stale other-story queued jobs are not accepted as current-story success.

happy.desc: Focused authority runner contract and live smokes pass after the selector change.

edge.desc: Regression coverage models a stale queued job from another story and proves the current story claim remains story-scoped.

adversarial.desc: SSE jobs.available remains advisory in test coverage; signed POST /jobs/claim is still required for ownership.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-runner-contracts-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-runner-client-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-job-loop-live-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build plus all three focused authority runner smokes passed after the selector change.
Regression models stale B-other queued work and proves the signed B-auto claim receives and completes the current-story job.
SSE jobs.available remains advisory: signed POST /jobs/claim is still required, and hinted jobIds are not treated as ownership.
